basic_profile.bio: A 31-year-old craft beer enthusiast hailing from Chandigarh, India, who recently relocated to New Orleans. I work as a software developer and often spend my evenings exploring local breweries and beer festivals. I'm single and tend to stay online during late nights, often browsing Reddit after work. I enjoy discussing comedy shows, especially Tom Segura's, and dislike unreliable streaming services.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I hold a degree in computer science and have worked in the tech industry for several years. My interest in craft beer started as a hobby and has grown through self-teaching and attending local events.
